MEMO

To:      Alistair Black

Fax #: 023-999-9998

From: Wendy Hartwell [Travel]

Fax #: 023-998-9998

Dear Mr. Black,

As requested. I am sending you a detailed itinerary for your forthcoming trip to Italy. As you will see, both your outgoing and return flights have been confirmed, and I have reserved an aisle seat both ways, I have been in direct contact with our Pisa branch, and they have obtained the schedule of meetings and events planned for your stay in Italy.We have succeeded in arranging a brief meeting with Mr. Paolo Svegli of the Italian Motor Vehicle Manufacturers Association, although he is willing to give no more than 1 hour of his time, I know that you have already been in touch with him by email, so I think that this should be long enough to discuss your proposal in person. If he is interested enough to set up this initial meeting, I think we may have a good chance of setting up the contract.

You'll have one morning of sightseeing before you leave.The guide will take you directly to the airport. Don't hesitate to get in touch if you have any questions.

Have a good trip.

Regards,

Wendy Hartwell.

childQuestions.questionText: What is probably the purpose of Alistair Black's trip?
options: To set up a new factory
To have an aisle seat
To fly to Tokyo
To set up' a contract with an Italian motor manufacturer
correctOptions: To set up' a contract with an Italian motor manufacturer
childQuestions.transcript: Wendy writes: “I think we may have a good chance of setting up the contract.” => This suggests the main purpose of the trip is business negotiations for a contract.

childQuestions.questionText: To whom will Alistair Black be making presentations?
options: The Board of Directors and the Export Division
Paolo Svegli and the Chief Engineers
Maria Modesta
Employees at two factories
correctOptions: The Board of Directors and the Export Division
childQuestions.transcript:
The itinerary shows:

  • May 3rd, 16:30 → Presentation to the Board of Directors
  • May 4th, 16:00 → Presentation to the Export Division

childQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements is probably NOT true?
options: Alistair Black has been communicating with Paolo Svegli.
Paolo Svegli has little spare time to meet with Alistair Black.
Alistair Black has Paolo Svegli's email address.
Alistair Black is good friends with Paolo Svegli.
correctOptions: Alistair Black is good friends with Paolo Svegli.
childQuestions.transcript:
The memo says: “you have already been in touch with him by email” => This shows they have communicated, but there is no evidence they are friends.

The other statements are supported by the text:

  • He has Paolo's email address. 
  • He has been communicating with Paolo. 
  • Paolo has little spare time (only one hour available).

childQuestions.questionText: Whom will Mr. Black probably be traveling with?
options: No one
With a business associate
Paolo Svegli
With his spouse
childQuestions.transcript: The hotel reservation is for: “2 nights, single room”. Also, there is no mention of a spouse or business associate traveling with him.

childQuestions.questionText: How long will Mr. Black spend sightseeing?
options: One full day
3 days and 2 nights
No time during this trip
Several hours
childQuestions.transcript: The itinerary says: “9:00–13:00 sightseeing” => This is 4 hours, which is several hours, not a full day.

cards.questionText:
Agenda

Personnel Department Monthly Meeting 

Monday 14th July, 4:30 p.m

Interview Room 3

New Business

  • Appointment of new department head
  • Relocation - new office sites
  • New policy on interviewing
  • New employee health insurance system

Reports

  • Interviewer training committee
  • Employee relations workshop

Other business

(please notify me by July 10th if you have other items to add)

MEMO

To:      All Personnel Department employees

From: Ursula

Date: July 2nd

Re:    Meeting agenda

This is a quick reminder about this month's meeting, which will be held a week earlier than usual. This is because the third Monday this month is a national holiday, and all offices will be closed. Be sure to make a note of this date because absences will not be excused. In addition, please note the change of location. It will be held in interview room 3 this time, not room 2 because of complaints about the broken air conditioner. The management has decided not to fix the air conditioning because we will be relocating around the middle of August. The new location of our office is item number 3 on the agenda. Please bring any ideas you have on facilities that you feel should be provided in our new location. I will be handing out forms at the meeting for you to fill in with your ideas. There will be an explanation of our new employee health insurance system. Mark Southwold will be explaining how the new system will save you money, while increasing overall coverage. He has asked me to inform you that he is willing to talk one on one with anyone interested, but please make an appointment with his secretary first.

Because we have a lot of important things to discuss, I foresee the meeting running a little longer than usual, so please be sure to arrive on time.

childQuestions.questionText: Why is the meeting earlier than usual?
options: The regular time is being moved from Mondays.
There was no meeting last month.
The regular meeting day will be a day off this month.
The company felt that it was time for a change.
correctOptions: The regular meeting day will be a day off this month.
childQuestions.transcript: The memo says: “the third Monday this month is a national holiday, and all offices will be closed.” => Therefore, the meeting is held earlier.

childQuestions.questionText: What would have been the date of the meeting if it had not been changed?
options: July 21st
Monday
July 28th
Seven days early
childQuestions.transcript:
The meeting is on Monday, July 14th, which is one week earlier than usual.

One week later is Monday, July 21st, so that would have been the original date.

childQuestions.questionText: Why isn't the management going to repair the air conditioning?
options: The company will move to another building.
It is too expensive.
The weather is cooler these days.
They are waiting for permission.
correctOptions: The company will move to another building.
childQuestions.transcript: The memo says: “The management has decided not to fix the air conditioning because we will be relocating around the middle of August.” => So they are moving soon and do not want to repair it.

options: People who want to add items to the agenda
People who will be absent from the meeting
People who wish to attend the meeting
People who want to consult Mark Southwold
correctOptions: People who want to add items to the agenda
childQuestions.transcript: The agenda states: “please notify me by July 10th if you have other items to add”

childQuestions.questionText: Which of the following statements is NOT true?
options: The personnel department will have a new head.
The new insurance system is costlier than the old one.
The department has at least three interview rooms.
The department is changing its interview policy.
correctOptions: The new insurance system is costlier than the old one.
childQuestions.transcript:
The memo says: “the new system will save you money” => So the new insurance system is less expensive, not more expensive.

The other statements are supported:

  • New department head → agenda item 
  • New interviewing policy → agenda item 
  • Interview Room 3 implies there are at least 3 interview rooms
